name: S1
description: Scaled-down RTX 5070, f = 1/48: one Vortex core (issue 4 x 32 threads = 128 lanes/cycle) stands for one of the 5070's 48 SMs; DRAM bandwidth and L2 scaled by the same 1/48; L3 off.

sources.scaling: f = cores/48 = 1/48 (DESIGN_BRIEF.md: one Vortex core = one 5070 SM: issue 4 x 32 threads = 128 lanes/cycle = 4 SMSPs x 32).
sources.NUM_WARPS, NUM_THREADS, ISSUE_WIDTH: 32 warps x 32 threads, issue 4 (brief's S1 starting point; threads per warp fixed at 32 by rule 3; the 5070 holds up to 48 warps/SM, so 32 is below the real occupancy limit).
sources.DCACHE_SIZE: 128 KB per core = the sm_120 unified L1/shared size per SM. INFERENCE (not recorded in any measurement here; note 08 sec. 7). 4 ways = Vortex default (real associativity unknown).
sources.DCACHE_MSHR_SIZE, L2_MSHR_SIZE: 128 each: Little's law at 14 GB/s = 5.57 B/cycle x ~760-cycle loaded latency = 4.2 KB = 66 x 64 B lines in flight; 128 leaves 2x headroom so MSHRs never cap the request rate (default 16 caps at ~1.4 B/cycle).
sources.L2_SIZE, L2_NUM_WAYS, L2_NUM_BANKS: 48 MB (measured) / 48 = 1 MB, 16 ways (as profiles/rtx5080.json). 1 bank = 64 B/cycle for hits (faithful share: 1,138 B/cycle chip-wide measured / 48 = 23.7 B/cycle; no smaller knob).
sources.PLATFORM_CLOCK_RATE: 2512 MHz: the 5070's boost clock as reported by Nsight Compute device__attribute_clock_rate (owner's rtx5070q profile). The latency micro-benchmark ran at 2.866 GHz; latencies are converted through ns.
sources.PLATFORM_MEMORY_TYPE, NUM_BANKS, DATA_RA: 672 GB/s / 48 = 14.0 GB/s, modelled as 4 narrow GDDR6 x16 channels x 2 B x 1750 MT/s = 14.0 GB/s = 5.57 B/core-cycle (note 08 option C: narrow channels, more banks, fewer row conflicts). GDDR7 is not modelled by Ramulator; GDDR6 timing stands in for it.
sources.PLATFORM_MEMORY_LATENCY: 503 added core cycles on every DRAM read: calibrated so that the unloaded load-to-use latency of a DRAM miss (pointer chase over 32 MB, results/calibration.csv) is 752.7 cycles = 299.6 ns, matching the 5070's measured 858 cycles @ 2.866 GHz = 299 ns (gpu_bw/latency.cu). 518 (owner's value) gave 767 cycles. The remaining ~250 cycles are cache pipeline + Ramulator GDDR6 row miss.
sources.SCHED_QUEUE_SIZE, ROW_VISIT_BITS: owner's patched knobs (vortex_dram_knobs.patch); Ramulator defaults (32 entries; 128 B row visit) unless calibration changes them (calibration.csv).
sources.EXT_A_ENABLE: RISC-V A extension on: OpenCL global/local atomics (the 5070 has atomic units in L2 and shared memory); needed by the group-by kernel. Requires write-through L1 (Vortex default here).
sources.CACHE_WRITE_VALIDATE: 1 (project patch vortex_l2_write_validate.patch): a store that overwrites a whole 64 B sector allocates it in the write-back L2 without a fill read, as NVIDIA L2s do for full 32 B-sector writes. Upstream simx always fetches on a write miss, which added ~1 read per written byte (runs/test/chain_q1: cast 4->8 B read 754 KB for 237 KB of input).
sources.CACHE_SET_HASH: 1 (project patch vortex_cache_set_hash.patch): XOR-hashed set index in L1 and L2, as GPU caches hash. Without it the Vortex per-thread stacks (8 KB apart) map to 8 L2 sets (4 L1 sets) and every register spill thrashes them: tile_scan_apply_i32 wrote 20.5k DRAM lines for a 3.7k-line output (runs/test).
sources.calibration: stream read (vx_membw, 16 MB): S1 13.80 GB/s = 98.6 % of 14.0; S4 52.6 GB/s = 93.9 % of 56.0 (results/calibration.csv); brief threshold 85 %. Option C (narrow channels) reached it on the first attempt; 1 x 7000 MT/s reached only 77 %.
sources.DCACHE_NUM_BANKS (default 1): Vortex default for 32 lanes: 1 bank x 64 B words = 64 B/cycle; the 5070 SM L1 measured 116 B/cycle (gpu_bw/membw.cu). Not raised: no kernel here is L1-bandwidth-bound.
sources.LMEM (default 64 KB): VX_CFG_LMEM_LOG_SIZE default 16 = 64 KB local memory per core (the 5070 allows up to 100 KB shared per SM).
